skills.name: Look, Leonin Crystal!
skills.description: Joy summons a <font color='#404495'>(Leonin Crystal)</font> at the target location, dealing 200<font color='#27C0C7'>( +40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The <font color='#404495'>(Leonin Crystal)</font> lasts up to 2s.
skills.tips: Use this skill in tandem with the Second Skill, or to harass enemies and activate the Passive.

skills.name: Meow, Rhythm of Joy!
skills.description:
Joy dashes in the target direction, dealing 120<font color='#27C0C7'>( +55% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies in her path. Hitting an enemy or the <font color='#404495'>(Leonin Crystal)</font> allows Joy to cast this skill again within 1s and gain 1 <font color='#404495'>(Beat Energy)</font>. Casting this skill on the beat increases the skill damage by 100% and grants a 80<font color='#27C0C7'>( +60% Total Magic Power)</font> shield that lasts 3s.
This skill can be cast up to 4 times in succession.
skills.tips: This skill is Joy's main damage source. Casting this skill on the beat unlocks the Ultimate.

skills.name: Ha, Electrifying Beats!
skills.description:
Joy increases her Physical & Magic Defense by 15<font color='#27C0C7'>( +10% Total Magic Power)</font> and gains 30% Movement Speed. Over the next 4s, she pulses 8 times, dealing 135<font color='#27C0C7'>( +50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> each time to nearby enemies. Each subsequent hit on the same enemy deals 15% less damage (down to 40% of the original damage).
Each <font color='#404495'>(Meow, Rhythm of Joy!)</font> cast on the beat increases this skill's damage by 40%. If perfect rhythm is achieved by hitting every beat with <font color='#404495'>(Meow, Rhythm of Joy!)</font>, Joy also gains 40% Spell Vamp while this skill is active.
This skill unlocks when Joy acquires <font color='#404495'>(Beat Energy)</font>. Casting this skill with <Num10> <font color='#404495'>(Beat Energy)</font> will remove all debuffs on Joy and make her immune to control effects while this skill is active.
skills.tips: Use this ultimate damage skill to deal massive damage and finish off enemies.

skills.name: Humph, Joy's Angry!
skills.description:
Joy becomes <font color='#404495'>(Angry!)</font> each time her skill hits a non-Minion enemy, dealing 100<font color='#27C0C7'>( +100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> and increasing her Movement Speed by 60% that decays over 4s (hitting the <font color='#404495'>(Leonin Crystal)</font> will also grant the Movement Speed effect). This effect has a cooldown of 4s for each target.
Joy's Basic Attack will deal 65<font color='#D58E1F'>( +25% Total Physical Attack)</font>  <font color='#27C0C7'>(+65% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font>.
skills.tips: This Passive skill grants you more agility and protection!

items.name: Genius Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Magic: Dealing Magic Damage to enemy heroes will reduce their Magic Defense by 3-7 (scales with level) for 2s. Stacks up to 3 times.

items.name: Ice Queen Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Ice Bound: When a skill deals damage to an enemy hero, it will also slow them by 10% for 2s (stacks up to 3 times). This effect has a 1s cooldown.

items.name: Fleeting Time
items.des: Unique Passive - Timestream: Hero kills or assists reduce the Ultimate's current cooldown by 30%.

items.name: Holy Crystal
items.des: Unique Passive - Mystery: Gains 21%-35% extra Magic Power (scales with level).

items.name: Blood Wings
items.des: Unique Passive - Guard: Gains a shield equal to 200% of Magic Power. The shield will regenerate 20s after being damaged, and grants 30 Movement Speed while it lasts.

builds.tips: For equipment, we recommend this build as it can provide Joy with damage output as well as survivability.
